homepage.spectrum.description.message: Three distinct approaches to AI in software development. This book teaches you both AI-Driven and AI-Native development.

homepage.spectrum.aiAssistedDesc.message: AI improves your productivity with code completion, debugging assistance, and documentation generation.

homepage.spectrum.aiDrivenDesc.message: AI generates significant code from specifications. You act as architect, director, and reviewer.

homepage.spectrum.aiNativeDesc.message: Applications architected around AI capabilities. LLMs and agents are core functional components.

homepage.feature.coLearningDesc.message: Learn alongside AI agents. Not just using AI as a tool, but co-creating where both human and AI learn together.

homepage.feature.dualLanguageDesc.message: Python for reasoning & intelligence, TypeScript for interaction & UI. Master the bilingual AI-native stack.

homepage.feature.specDrivenDesc.message: Write specifications that both humans and AI understand. Specs become executable blueprints for intelligent systems.

homepage.feature.agenticDesc.message: Build with OpenAI Agents SDK and Google ADK. Create agents that reason, act, and collaborate autonomously.

homepage.feature.architectureDesc.message: Cloud-native deployment with Docker, Kubernetes, Dapr, and Ray. Scalable, secure, fault-tolerant systems.

homepage.feature.journeyDesc.message: 46 comprehensive chapters from programming basics to deploying enterprise agentic AI systems in production.
